               Mech Royale Deep Strategy Dossier
Prepared for competitive optimization of the Builders Mech Royale track.


Mech Royale Competitive Intelligence Dossier
A deep strategic blueprint focused on placement optimization, belief-state modeling, agent
orchestration, protocol exploitation, map intelligence, and experiment design. Detailed analysis
should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests,
and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with
instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

Core Thesis
This is not a shooter competition. It is a survival optimization competition disguised as a shooter.
Placement determines score. Every subsystem should maximize expected placement rather than
kills. Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each
module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard
feedback loops.

Reward Function Analysis
Expected placement dominates all other objectives. Kills matter only through cubes, upgrades, loot,
and removal of threats. A bot that consistently places top 4 can outperform an inconsistent
aggressive winner. Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry
logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should
expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and
leaderboard feedback loops.

World Model Architecture
Maintain persistent enemy state, sound-derived hypotheses, projectile tracking, drop tracking, zone
forecasts, and threat heatmaps. Treat every observation as evidence feeding a belief state.
Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each
module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard
feedback loops.

Agent Swarm Design
Survival Agent, Zone Agent, Threat Agent, Combat Agent, Weapon Agent, Loot Agent, Ambush
Agent. Each proposes utility scores. Meta-controller performs dynamic weighted arbitration.
Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each
module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard
feedback loops.

Threat Heatmap
Represent the map as cells. Increase risk around observed enemies, recent sounds, beams,
projectiles, supply drops, and likely rotations. Decay confidence over time. Detailed analysis should
expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and
leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation,
telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.
Sound Intelligence
Infer enemy movement from footsteps, boosts, reloads, mortar launches, laser charge sounds,
lightning discharges, and death events. Fuse multiple observations into location distributions.
Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each
module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard
feedback loops.

Combat Doctrine
Never take fair fights. Seek weapon advantage, rear armor exposure, third-party engagements,
low-HP targets, or drop contests. Retreat from symmetric fights. Detailed analysis should expand
each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and
leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation,
telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

Weapon Matchups
Laser > Mortar. Mortar > Lightning. Lightning > Laser. Maintain matchup-aware engagement
policies and pickup priorities. Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation,
telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed
analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations,
ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

Map Processing
Preprocess world.json and terrain files. Build visibility graph, cover graph, roof graph, navigation
mesh, line-of-sight cache, and elevation lookup tables. Detailed analysis should expand each
module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard
feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry
logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

Zone Planning
Future circle is always visible. Optimize expected travel cost to future safe positions. Arrive early
rather than rotating through convergence routes. Detailed analysis should expand each module
with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback
loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

Supply Drop Game Theory
Drops create predictable convergence. Contest only when expected cube gain exceeds mortality
risk. Ambushing contestants may outperform direct capture. Detailed analysis should expand each
module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard
feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry
logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

House Bot Research Plan
Experimentally identify target-selection heuristics, pathing weaknesses, drop preferences, weapon
priorities, and retreat behaviors. Detailed analysis should expand each module with
instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback
loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.
Overfitting Risk
Practice seeds remain stable. Maintain separate exploitation and generalization variants. Avoid
training solely against static practice behavior. Detailed analysis should expand each module with
instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback
loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility
equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.

Implementation Plan
Week 0: navigation + world model. Week 1: threat heatmap. Week 2: utility arbitration. Week 3:
behavior tuning and experiments. Detailed analysis should expand each module with
instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback
loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility

Winning Hypothesis
The strongest bot will likely be a deterministic world-model planner that leverages memory, sound
fusion, threat estimation, zone forecasting, and survival-first decision theory. Detailed analysis
should expand each module with instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests,
and leaderboard feedback loops.Detailed analysis should expand each module with
instrumentation, telemetry logging, utility equations, ablation tests, and leaderboard feedback loops.
